apps.name: Calendar

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate:
tell application "Calendar"
  tell calendar "Calendar"
    make new event with properties {summary:"{{title}}", start date:date "{{startDate}}", end date:date "{{endDate}}"}
  end tell
end tell
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Create a calendar event with title, start, and end time

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate:
tell application "Calendar"
  set today to current date
  set todayEnd to today + (1 * days)
  set eventList to ""
  repeat with cal in calendars
    set evts to (every event of cal whose start date >= today and start date < todayEnd)
    repeat with e in evts
      set eventList to eventList & summary of e & ", "
    end repeat
  end repeat
  return eventList
end tell
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Get a list of today's calendar events

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate: tell application "Calendar" to activate
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Open and bring Calendar to the front

commonPatterns.userIntent: what meetings do I have today

knownIssues: CreateEventIntent may not be available on all macOS versions
AppleScript date parsing depends on system locale

apps.name: Contacts

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate:
tell application "Contacts"
  set results to every person whose name contains "{{query}}"
  set output to ""
  repeat with p in results
    set output to output & name of p & ": "
    try
      set output to output & value of first email of p
    end try
    set output to output & return
  end repeat
  return output
end tell
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Search for a contact by name and return their details

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate:
tell application "Contacts"
  set p to first person whose name is "{{name}}"
  return value of first phone of p
end tell
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Get the phone number of a specific contact

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate:

end tell
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Get the email address of a specific contact

knownIssues: Contact names must match exactly for direct lookup
Contacts may not have phone or email fields populated
